text:
Maya Patel (AE): quick heads-upPegasus Health wants an exec-ready presales summary and a single POC owner. I can run bridge but need clear action list.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): I can own tech. open items: fleet sizing, mixed GPU plan (A10 primary, H100 fallback), websocket throughput SLO.
Maya Patel (AE): customer asks: 5k concurrent ws, 99p <200ms, BYO-HSM attestation and rotation policy.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): request elevated quota for a 24h stress run to validate.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): approve temporary non-billable quota for testing. Maya, what's expected ARR if POC converts?
Maya Patel (AE): ~450k ARR indicated, 90-day trial ask.
Rajiv Menon (Customer Success): I'll draft onboarding/runbook: allowlist, peering, 2-week config, 4-week POC, post-test runbook.
Priya Sinha (Security): security asks: HSM attestation (vendor certs + FIPS/CC level), EU/CA residency confirmation, SIGQ answers, key rotation policy.
Dan Keller (Legal): legal asks: logging retention, liability for BYO keys; need vendor list to draft addendum.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): unblock checklist: 1) quota, 2) mixed-GPU notes on variance, 3) BYO-HSM integration timeline (2-3w), 4) ws stress config.
Maya Patel (AE): Pegasus legal to send vendor list tomorrow. can we give quota earlier? they want smoke test today.
deploy-bot: quota-change request #Q-4821 created by Claire Nguyen requested: 24h elevated GPU burst.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): eng-infra please approve and timebox window.
deploy-bot: quota-change #Q-4821 approved by eng-infra-lead window: 2025-11-12T16:00Z to 2025-11-13T16:00Z.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): quota live, starting smoke tests now. will post results shortly.
Priya Sinha (Security): sending attestation template to Pegasus security, cc: Dan, Maya. we require vendor certs and rotation schedule.
Dan Keller (Legal): drafting addendum with BYO-HSM carveouts and data residency clause. will share redline EOD.
Rajiv Menon (Customer Success): runbook snippet: allowlist IPs, deploy test model to dedicated pool, enable prefix caching, run 24h harness, success criteria = 5k ws + 99p <200ms + TLS error <0.1%.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): quick harness sample: curl loop flooding generate endpoint with short sleep. (posted in internal gist).
Mateo Ruiz (SE): 2h into test: sustained ~4.8k ws, 99p ~210ms with A10 primary + occasional H100 fallback spikes. collecting traces to tune batching.
Maya Patel (AE): good. if we can shave ~15ms on 99p we hit CX target. please log next steps.
Priya Sinha (Security): received vendor list. starting HSM validation.
Dan Keller (Legal): addendum draft incoming.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): thanks team. Maya to schedule exec bridge with Pegasus for tomorrow morning, 30 min. :thumbsup:
